title: AMFI Guidelines on Net Asset Value (NAV) Calculation and Cut-Off Timings
source: Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI)
content: Net Asset Value (NAV) represents the per-unit market value of a mutual fund scheme, calculated as (Total Assets - Liabilities) / Total Outstanding Units. Under AMFI and SEBI regulations, NAV for subscription or redemption is determined by official cut-off timings (3:00 PM for equity/debt schemes, 1:30 PM for liquid funds). Applicable NAV depends on realization of funds in the scheme bank account before the cut-off deadline.
